value: STEINS;GATE (シュタインズ・ゲート, Shutainzu Gēto)
text: The title is stylized as STEINS;GATE in capitals, and its katakana reading is Shutainzu Gēto.
excerpt: シュタインズ・ゲート ゼロ

text: The original Steins;Gate visual novel was developed by the two companies 5pb. and Nitroplus.
excerpt: developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus

text: The visual novel first came out on the Xbox 360 on October 15, 2009.
excerpt: Original Xbox 360 release: October 15, 2009

text: Chiyomaru Shikura planned the game, Naotaka Hayashi wrote the scenario and the artist Huke designed the characters.
excerpt: planning headed by Chiyomaru Shikura; Naotaka Hayashi wrote scenarios; characters designed by Huke

text: Takeshi Abo composed the music of the original visual novel.
excerpt: Composer: Takeshi Abo

text: Steins;Gate belongs to the Science Adventure series and is its second game, after Chaos;Head.
excerpt: second game in the Science Adventure series, following Chaos;Head

value: Stein, the German word for stone
text: The title has no fixed meaning: it is built from the German word Stein, which means stone, and is a nod to the physicist Albert Einstein.
excerpt: coined from the German word "Stein" meaning stone, and tying in with famous physicist Albert Einstein

text: The story takes place in the summer of 2010 in the district of Akihabara.
excerpt: set in the summer of 2010 ... in Akihabara

text: The hero founds the Future Gadget Laboratory, a small lab in Akihabara where the friends build their inventions.
excerpt: establishes the "Future Gadget Laboratory" (未来ガジェット研究所)

text: The PhoneWave, a device the friends have been developing, turns out to be a time machine.
excerpt: the "PhoneWave" he and his friends had been developing is, in fact, a time machine

text: D-Mails are messages sent to the past, and they begin to change the timeline in big ways.
excerpt: D-Mails (Dメール) ... which begin to cause major differences in the timeline

text: Okabe has the Reading Steiner ability, which lets him notice changes between different timelines, when nobody else can.
excerpt: "Reading Steiner" ... the only one who possesses the ability to determine changes between different timelines

text: Different timelines are called world lines, and a divergence meter is used to track how far they differ.
excerpt: worldline and divergence meter track timeline variations

text: The game is called a speculative science adventure, with branching scenarios that lead to several endings.
excerpt: a speculative science ADV ... branching scenarios

text: The Steins;Gate anime was animated by the studio White Fox.
excerpt: Studio: White Fox

text: The first anime has 24 episodes, which aired from April to September 2011.

text: Steins;Gate 0 takes place on the Beta timeline, where Okabe becomes a tester of the Amadeus artificial intelligence.

text: Rintaro Okabe is written 岡部 倫太郎 in Japanese and is the founder of the Future Gadget Laboratory.
excerpt: he is a kind-hearted and loyal friend, only playing up the Hououin Kyouma personality

text: Kurisu Makise is written 牧瀬 紅莉栖 in Japanese and is a neuroscience researcher.
excerpt: Having had her research published in the academic journal Science at this age, Kurisu is extremely talented.

text: Mayuri Shiina is written 椎名 まゆり in Japanese and is a childhood friend of Okabe.
excerpt: She has a distinctive sing-song way of speaking, and she typically sings tutturū

text: Itaru Hashida, nicknamed Daru, is written 橋田 至 in Japanese and is a hacker.
excerpt: He is very skilled in computer programming and with old and new computer hardware.

text: Moeka Kiryu is written 桐生 萌郁 in Japanese and is a tech journalist.
excerpt: She is very shy and prefers to talk to someone by sending them a text message instead of speaking.

text: Luka Urushibara is written 漆原 るか in Japanese and is a friend of Okabe.
excerpt: His appearance and mannerisms are quite feminine as a result of his upbringing.

value: Faris NyanNyan (フェイリス・ニャンニャン)
text: Faris NyanNyan, whose real name is Rumiho Akiha, is written フェイリス・ニャンニャン in Japanese and works in a maid cafe.
excerpt: Her family owns Akihabara, and she was the driving force behind it becoming the city of moe.

text: Suzuha Amane is written 阿万音 鈴羽 in Japanese and is a time traveler.
excerpt: Later it is discovered that she is actually the time traveler known as John Titor.

text: Yugo Tennouji is written 天王寺 裕吾 in Japanese and is Okabe's landlord, also known as Mr. Braun.
excerpt: He is usually rough and impatient, especially when interacting with Okabe, but acts dotingly over his daughter.

text: Nae Tennouji is written 天王寺 綯 in Japanese and is the daughter of Yugo Tennouji.

text: Doctor Nakabachi is written ドクター中鉢 in Japanese; his real name is Shouichi Makise, and he is the father of Kurisu.
